features.title: Workspace layout
features.summary: The workspace keeps your files, editing controls, preview, and timeline in separate areas. Use it to find what you need while editing.

tour.text: Look in the Assets panel to browse files and editing resources.
Look in the Properties panel to inspect the selected item.
Look at the Preview panel to see your video.
Look at the Timeline panel to see how your clips are arranged.

features.title: Asset panel
features.summary: The Assets panel holds your media and other items you can add to a project. Use its tabs to find them.

tour.text: Look in the Assets panel for items to add to your project.
Click Media to view the files in your project.

features.title: Preview
features.summary: The Preview panel shows what your video looks like at the current position. Use it to check your edits.

tour.text: Look at the Preview panel to check how your video looks.

features.title: Properties
features.summary: The Properties panel shows settings for the item you select. Use it to make changes to clips and other items.

tour.text: Select an item, then look in Properties to see its settings.

features.title: Timeline
features.summary: The timeline arranges video, audio, and other clips over time. Use it to build and adjust your video.

tour.text: Look at the timeline to see your clips and their order.

features.title: Movable buttons
features.summary: You can rearrange buttons in the top bar and editing toolbars. Move the ones you use most to convenient places.

tour.text: Press and hold a top-bar button, then drag it to a new position.
Press and hold a timeline tool button, then drag it along its toolbar.

features.title: Search and workspace switcher
features.summary: The top search area helps you find commands, and its workspace menu changes the layout. Use either to move around Dafin.

tour.text: Click the search field to find commands, or click the workspace name to switch layouts.

features.title: Media library
features.summary: The Media library holds files added to your project. Open it to find footage, pictures, and sound for your edit.

tour.text: Click Media to find files you have added to the project.

features.title: Scenes
features.summary: Scenes finds shot changes in a selected video and lists the results. Use it to jump to parts of a long clip.

tour.text: Click Scenes to find shot changes in a selected video.

features.title: Your own files
features.summary: You can add your own animations, sounds, and title files to the matching tabs. Use this to keep your assets available in Dafin.

tour.text: Drag an animation file onto Stickers to add it to your library.
Drag an audio file onto Audio to add it to your library.
Drag a title template onto Titles to add it to your library.

features.title: Stock media
features.summary: Stock media lets you find video clips from online collections. Use them when you need footage you have not recorded.

tour.text: Click Stock Video to browse available footage.

features.title: Sound effects and music
features.summary: The Audio tab contains music and sound effects, including sounds supplied with Dafin. Use them to add sound to your video.

tour.text: Click Audio to browse music and sound effects.

features.title: Titles
features.summary: Titles add words to your video, such as headings or names. Use Properties to change how the selected text looks.

tour.text: Click Titles to browse text options for your video.
Select a title, then open Properties to change its appearance.

features.title: Title templates
features.summary: Title templates provide ready-made text styles and animations. Use them when you want a starting point for on-screen words.

tour.text: Click Titles to browse title templates.
Select a template title, then use Properties to change its text and style.

features.title: .mogrt titles
features.summary: Dafin can add supported .mogrt templates as titles, though some need a separate converter. Use Properties to edit their available controls.

tour.text: Click Titles to find imported .mogrt templates.
Select a .mogrt title, then look in Properties for its available controls.

features.title: Stickers (Lottie)
features.summary: Stickers add graphics and animations to your video. Use them to draw attention to something on screen.

tour.text: Click Stickers to browse available graphics and animations.

features.title: Shapes
features.summary: Shapes add simple graphic elements, such as rectangles or circles. Use them to highlight or frame parts of your video.

tour.text: Click Shapes to browse the available shapes.

features.title: Effects
features.summary: Effects change how a clip looks or sounds. Use Properties to adjust an effect after adding it.

tour.text: Click Effects to browse the available effects.
Select a clip with an effect, then open Properties to adjust its settings.

features.title: Transitions
features.summary: Transitions change how one clip leads into another. Use them when you want a different change between shots.

tour.text: Click Transitions to browse ways to move between clips.

features.title: Templates and split screen
features.summary: Templates include layouts that can show several clips at once. Use a split-screen layout to put multiple views in one frame.

tour.text: Click Templates to find ready-made layouts, including split screens.

features.title: Masks
features.summary: Masks control which parts of a clip remain visible. Use them to reveal one area while hiding another.

tour.text: Click Masks to browse shapes that can hide parts of a clip.

features.title: Subtitles
features.summary: Subtitles show spoken words as text on your video. Use them to help viewers follow the dialogue.

tour.text: Click Subtitles to open the subtitle tools.

features.title: Speech
features.summary: Speech turns written text into spoken audio using a chosen voice. Use it to add narration without recording it yourself.

tour.text: Click Speech to open the text-to-speech tools.

features.title: AI tools
features.summary: The AI tab groups tools that can help with tasks such as making captions. Open it to see which tools are available.

tour.text: Click AI to see the available tools and those coming later.

features.title: Auto captions
features.summary: Auto captions turns speech in a clip into timed subtitles. Use it when you want captions without typing every line.

tour.text: Click AI to find the Auto captions tool.
Look at the timeline to see where generated captions are placed.

features.title: Select and cut
features.summary: Select lets you work with clips, while Cut splits them into pieces. Switch between the tools as you edit.

tour.text: Click Select to choose and move clips on the timeline.
Click Cut to split a clip where you need a break.

features.title: Keyframes
features.summary: Keyframes let a setting change at different points in a clip. Use them to make changes happen over time.

tour.text: Click Keyframe to use the keyframe tool.
Look at the timeline to choose where a change should happen.

features.title: Snapping
features.summary: Snapping helps clips and the playhead line up with nearby positions. Turn it on when you want clips to meet neatly.

tour.text: Click Snap to turn timeline snapping on or off.

features.title: Chroma key
features.summary: Chroma key hides a chosen color in a clip, often a green background. Use it to place another picture behind a subject.

tour.text: Click Chroma Key to open the background-color removal tool.
Look in Properties to adjust the selected clip.

features.title: Motion tracking
features.summary: Motion tracking follows movement in a clip. Use it to track where an object goes across the picture.

tour.text: Click Motion Tracking to start working with a moving subject.
Look at the Preview panel to see the picture you are tracking.

features.title: Sync audio
features.summary: Sync audio lines up recordings that share the same sound. Use it to match camera footage with separately recorded audio.

tour.text: Select the recordings, then click Sync Audio to line them up.

features.title: Volume dots
features.summary: Volume dots let you raise or lower sound at different moments in a clip. Use them for gradual fades or quieter sections.

tour.text: Look at audio clips in the timeline to find their volume lines.

features.title: Automatic track stacking
features.summary: Automatic track stacking places overlapping clips on separate tracks when needed. Use it to keep clips aligned without replacing each other.

tour.text: Drag a clip onto an occupied part of the timeline to place it on a free track.

features.title: Projects: new, open, save
features.summary: Projects store your clips and editing choices. Use the project controls to start, reopen, and save your work.

tour.text: Click Projects to start a new project or open an existing one.
Click Save to keep your latest project changes.

features.title: Open Premiere Pro and Filmora projects
features.summary: Dafin can open supported Premiere Pro and Filmora projects as new edits. Use this to bring their clip arrangements into Dafin.

tour.text: Click Projects, then choose Open to select a supported project file.

features.title: Video size and layout
features.summary: Video size and layout control the shape and dimensions of your project. Use these settings for landscape or portrait videos.

tour.text: Click Video to open the video size and layout settings.

features.title: Export
features.summary: Export creates a video file from your finished project. Use it when you want to watch or share the result outside Dafin.

tour.text: Click Export to choose how to save the finished video.

features.title: Export presets (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, WhatsApp)
features.summary: Export presets provide starting settings for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and WhatsApp. Use one before adjusting any settings yourself.

tour.text: Click Export to find the presets for common sharing platforms.

features.title: Keyboard shortcuts
features.summary: Keyboard shortcuts let you control editing actions with keys. Use the shortcut list to find or change them.

tour.text: Click Shortcuts to view or change your keyboard shortcuts.

features.title: Marketplace
features.summary: The Marketplace lets you find optional items for Dafin and manage downloads. Use it when you want to add more content.

tour.text: Click Marketplace to browse items and check downloads.

features.title: Extras
features.summary: Extras contains optional packs and related updates. Open it to see what is available or needs attention.

tour.text: Click Extras to view optional packs and updates.

features.title: Notifications
features.summary: Notifications show messages about activity and updates in Dafin. Open them to review anything you have missed.

tour.text: Click Notifications to read recent messages.

features.title: Agent access
features.summary: Agent access lets a compatible assistant connect to Dafin during your editing session. Use it when you want an assistant to help.

tour.text: Click Agent to open the access controls.

features.title: Settings
features.summary: Settings let you change how Dafin looks and works. Open them to adjust the editor to your needs.

tour.text: Click Settings to change your editor preferences.

features.title: Updates
features.summary: Updates help you check whether a newer version of Dafin is available. Use them to keep your editor current.

tour.text: Click Settings to find the update options.

features.title: Tutorial
features.summary: The Tutorial lists Dafin features and offers guided tours. Use it to learn where tools are and what they do.

tour.text: Click Tutorial to browse features and start a guided tour.
